title: Last light, one sail
intro: A sample story. Tap through to see how a photograph can carry its own notes.
altText: An illustrated dusk seascape: a low sun on the horizon, a dark triangular sail to its right, and a column of light on the water.

chapters.title: Where the light goes
chapters.body: Every chapter points at one place in the picture and says what is there. Here, the sun sits right on the horizon and the sky warms around it.

chapters.title: The sail
chapters.body: The camera moves between chapters, so the viewer looks where you want them to look, in the order you choose.

chapters.title: What the water kept
chapters.body: Add your own notes to your photographs, and let people reply to a single detail. You can also explore the picture freely.
